title: The Card Debt and the Adjoining Suite

scenes.title: Dream Trial and Food Poisoning
scenes.summary: Denis dreams of a courtroom trial sentencing him for cheating on Katya with her mother, while Senya and Fedya fight over the bathroom with food poisoning.

scenes.title: Dzhekovich's Lost Bet
scenes.summary: Having lost a card bet to Barinov, Mikhail is forced to sing Barinov's praises in the lobby and crow like a rooster without pants when Vika walks by.

scenes.title: Tea with Cognac and a Date with Elena
scenes.summary: Katya confides in Nastya over cognac-spiked tea while Elena drops by to see Barinov and agrees to go on a proper date with him tomorrow.

scenes.title: Elena Invites Her Friend to Lunch
scenes.summary: After Barinov is summoned to the kitchen, Elena calls her friend Natasha and invites her to have lunch right now at Restaurant Victor.

scenes.title: Advice for a Romantic Evening
scenes.summary: Senya's wife Marina and Katya both complain about their men, so Nastya suggests a romantic bubble bath and offers Katya the empty apartment for the night.

scenes.title: Barinov in a Maid's Outfit
scenes.summary: Elena and her friend Natasha spot Barinov in the dining room wearing a French maid's dress after losing the card rematch to Mikhail.

scenes.title: Fedya in the Bathtub and Demanding a Rematch
scenes.summary: Marina bursts into the bathroom expecting Senya in the bubble bath only to find Fedya, while Barinov demands a third card game from Mikhail.

scenes.title: Denis's Cold Baguette
scenes.summary: Katya confronts Denis in the kitchen for skipping their night at the apartment and signing up for room service all week.

scenes.title: A Debt of Honor and Someone Else's Bouquet
scenes.summary: Barinov tries to apologize to Elena with a bouquet, defends his card debt as a matter of honor, and accidentally gives away a courier's flowers.

scenes.title: The Key to Suite 311 and Losing at Blackjack
scenes.summary: Katya persuades reception to give her the key to luxury suite 311, while Barinov loses a third blackjack game to Mikhail.

scenes.title: The 'Maid to the Room' Service
scenes.summary: Katya prepares suite 311 for Denis, while Mikhail forces Barinov to put the maid dress back on and deliver room service to suite 313.

scenes.title: Surprise in Suite 313 and Eleonora Checks In
scenes.summary: Suite 313 turns out to be booked by Elena, who invites Barinov for a romantic evening, while Eleonora checks into adjoining suite 311.

scenes.title: The Scottish Highlander at the Bar
scenes.summary: Wearing a Scottish kilt, Barinov grabs wine at the bar and learns from Mikhail that Eleonora has just checked into the luxury suite.

scenes.title: A Fruit Basket for Suite 311
scenes.summary: Nastya convinces a reluctant Denis to carry a fruit basket up to suite 311, where Eleonora is already taking a bath.

scenes.title: A Chicken Drumstick for Eleonora
scenes.summary: Denis delivers the fruit to suite 311 while Eleonora is in the bath, and Barinov enters the bedroom offering roast chicken to Eleonora in the dark.

scenes.title: Katya Calls Denis
scenes.summary: Eleonora declines eating after six while Barinov steps through the connecting door to Elena, and Katya calls Denis on his way downstairs.

scenes.title: A Gladiator in the Wrong Bedroom
scenes.summary: Barinov bursts into Eleonora's bedroom in a gladiator helmet, panics when he sees his boss, and begs her to leave so Elena won't spot her.

scenes.title: Collision Outside Suite 311
scenes.summary: Eleonora steps into the corridor and runs into Denis; when Denis insists on telling Katya the truth, Katya approaches and Eleonora hides in the bathroom.

scenes.title: A Bitter Lie to Save the Family
scenes.summary: With Eleonora hiding in the bathroom, Denis imagines how the truth would destroy Katya's bond with her mother, so he tells Katya he doesn't love her instead.

scenes.title: The Act of a Real Man
scenes.summary: Eleonora tells Denis he acted like a real man, while Barinov comforts a heartbroken Katya at the bar and Denis resolves to fix things.
